q: How much CO2 does an Indian coal power plant emit per kWh?
title: Coal power CO2 per kWh in India
short: About 0.971 kg CO2 per kWh of net generation on average in FY 2025-26, by CEA's database. Lignite plants averaged 1.348 and gas plants 0.470. These are station averages for the fuel, useful for comparing a captive plant against the grid average of 0.675.
audience: Plants with captive coal, lignite or gas generation comparing it with grid supply

sections.h: Weighted average by fuel, FY 2025-26, t CO2 per MWh net

p: Do not apply these averages to your own boiler or turbine if you have fuel data. Use the coal, lignite or gas you actually burned from purchase invoices, with its calorific value, and divide by the units you generated. The CEA averages are a benchmark to check against.

senseible: Senseible reads coal, lignite and gas purchase invoices and electricity bills into dated records per site, so a captive plant's figure is built from the fuel actually bought.
